exposure: PVL-MRSA presence (USA300 ST8 Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive meticillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus)
cohort: The participants included 18 patients (10 infections, 8 colonizations) and one colonized healthcare worker identified within a UK maternity and neonatal setting during an outbreak.
finding: An outbreak of PVL-MRSA in a UK maternity and neonatal setting, involving 18 cases, was successfully controlled by the exclusion and decolonization of a healthcare worker and implementation of infection prevention measures, with whole genome sequencing proving valuable in linking cases and confirming community transmission.
